## Active Storage: Possible arbitrary file write and read in image analysis

Source-reported by [GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-f3w6-w445-fwh9).

CVE-2026-122006 (official CVSS 9.8): The activestorage gem before 8.1.4.1 for Ruby on Rails, when ImageMagick attachment processing occurs, can allow server read and write operations (e.g., reading secret_key_base) because the ImageMagick analyzer runs when a file is attached, and there is not an ImageMagick security policy to block unintended functionality.

**What to do:** Upgrade to a fixed release: activestorage 8.1.4.1, activestorage 8.0.5.2.

| Claim | Check | Source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| CVE-2026-122006 exists | confirmed | [cve.org](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-122006) |
| CVSS 9.8 | official | [NVD](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-122006) |

Identifiers and scores checked automatically against cve.org and NVD.

**Limitations:** Source-reported; SecOpsAI did not reproduce the issue.

Published 12 Nov 2026, 23:46 UTC; first seen by SecOpsAI 12 Nov 2026, 23:53 UTC.

## Collection scope

SecOpsAI watched 29 sources for this edition; 1 was behind schedule: Maven Central Solr tail. 5 package registries are watched through release metadata only, without scanning package contents. This is not complete coverage of every source or registry.

## Credits and corrections

Prepared by Onyedika Christopher Agada. The editor approves each edition before it is published. Corrections keep the previous edition and explain material changes.
